ios.desc:
Globo is a geography quiz and trivia game where you can learn about the world, challenge real players, and test your knowledge across thousands of questions about countries, flags, capitals, maps, landmarks, foods, brands, and more.

Play quick single-player games, compete in 1v1 battles, join live multiplayer matches, or follow interactive geography courses designed to help you learn while you play.

WHAT CAN I LEARN WITH GLOBO?

Globo turns geography and world knowledge into games, quizzes, and interactive lessons.

* Countries, capitals, and flags
* Maps and country shapes
* Famous landmarks
* Foods from around the world
* Global brands and logos
* US states and territories
* Regions and dependent territories
* World facts, culture, and languages

CAN I COMPETE AGAINST OTHER PLAYERS?

Yes. Put your geography knowledge to the test against players from around the world.

* Live Arena with real-time multiplayer matches
* Quick 1v1 battles
* Challenge your friends
* Compare score, speed, and accuracy
* Climb leaderboards and ranked leagues

CAN I PLAY BY MYSELF?

Play fast-paced single-player Arcade games to practice, improve your score, or enjoy a quick geography challenge.

Choose topics like flags, capitals, maps, landmarks, countries, foods, brands, US states, and more. Improve your best scores, master different difficulty levels, and climb the leaderboards.

CAN GLOBO HELP ME LEARN GEOGRAPHY?

Globo is more than a trivia game. Interactive courses help you build your knowledge through short lessons, quizzes, maps, and challenges.

* World Geography: Learn countries, capitals, flags, maps, landmarks, and cultures
* US States Roadtrip: Explore states, capitals, landmarks, and regional facts
* Regional Courses: Explore Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, and Oceania

HOW CAN I TEST MY KNOWLEDGE?

* Compete in Live Arena
* Play head-to-head 1v1 Battles
* Chase high scores in Arcade
* Complete geography lessons and quizzes
* Climb leaderboards and leagues
* Discover new topics as you progress

IS GLOBO ONLY ABOUT COUNTRIES AND FLAGS?

There’s much more to explore. Discover landmarks, world foods, global brands, territories, cultures, regional facts, languages, and more.

IS GLOBO SUITABLE FOR BEGINNERS?

Yes. Globo is easy to start whether you already love geography or are just beginning to explore the world.

Start with familiar questions, discover new facts as you play, and take on harder quizzes as your knowledge grows.

show_hn.title: Show HN: An app to learn about the world

quotes.text:
Hi everyone,

I made an app to learn about countries of the world, including landmarks, culture, history, flags, and much more!

The idea is to make learning fun and engaging, but at the same time provide a clear, structured path, that makes learning effective and meaningful.

It has multiple game modes, where you can learn, play, compete and socialize with peers.

Check it out and let me know what you think!

The app is free to download:

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/globo-learn-world-geography/id6747730729

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.getglobo.android
